description: This file defines a React functional component named 'UserAgentActivity' that displays user agent activity statistics, including active users over different periods, success metrics, and detailed breakdowns with filtering. It fetches data from various API calls, manages multiple states, and renders charts and metrics within a tabbed interface.

methods.name: extractUserAgent
methods.description: Helper function to extract user agent string from a tag, removing the 'User-Agent: ' prefix if present.

methods.name: truncateUserAgent
methods.description: Helper function to truncate long user agent strings for display with a tooltip.

methods.name: getAllTagsForData
methods.description: Aggregates and sorts tags based on total active users for chart category selection.

methods.name: generateDailyChartData
methods.description: Generates an array representing daily user activity over the last 7 days for the DAU chart.

methods.name: generateWeeklyChartData
methods.description: Generates weekly aggregated user activity over the last 7 weeks for the WAU chart.

methods.name: generateMonthlyChartData
methods.description: Generates monthly aggregated user activity over the last 7 months for the MAU chart.

methods.name: formatAbbreviatedNumber
methods.description: Formats large numbers into abbreviated form with K or M suffix.
